verdict.rationale: GitHub Codespaces offers 'a full, cloud-based development environment in seconds' (github-docs-3), which could serve as an isolated environment separate from production, but there's no explicit documentation tying this to AI-agent testing or protecting production data specifically. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment guidance for AI agents, protections against touching production data, and independent verification that Codespaces or similar isolates from production systems.
